description: This file contains Go test functions for validating environment-based configurations for a documentation internationalization (i18n) provider and model selection logic. It tests how environment variables influence the behavior of functions like docsPiProvider() and docsPiModel().

methods.name: TestDocsPiProviderPrefersExplicitOverride
methods.description: Tests that the provider selection respects an explicit environment variable override.

methods.name: TestDocsPiProviderPrefersOpenAIEnvWhenAvailable
methods.description: Tests that the provider defaults to 'openai' when the relevant environment variable is set.

methods.name: TestDocsPiModelUsesProviderDefault
methods.description: Ensures that the default model is used when no specific model is set.

methods.name: TestDocsPiModelKeepsOpenAIDefaultAtGPT54
methods.description: Checks that the default OpenAI model is used when provider is set to 'openai' and no model override is provided.

methods.name: TestDocsPiModelPrefersExplicitOverride
methods.description: Verifies that an explicitly set model override is respected over defaults.
